id: title:Gilbert09:stop cloudflare audit logs sync failing on deep pagination

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion connector resilience against pagination metadata gaps
review.reason: The change adds a 400 status code to the skipped status codes for the Cloudflare billing_usage endpoint, allowing the warehouse ingestion connector to retain account records when pagination metadata is missing rather than failing the entire account sync. This is a substantive, bounded reliability improvement for warehouse ingestion, demonstrated by the implementation and a test. No
review.uncertainty: The benefit is demonstrated by the code, but the actual production impact and frequency of this specific pagination edge case are not independently verified. The tier is assigned based on the implementation and test, not on unverified adoption or incident avoidance.

observations.limitations: This chunk contains two hunks. P1.F1.H1 is a production implementation change. P1.F2.H1 is a test implementation. The review below treats P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H1 as a single group, but P1.F2.H1 does not demonstrate the benefit of P1.F1.H1; it only checks the failure behavior. No score is assigned. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a 400 status code to the list of skipped status codes for the Cloudflare billing_usage endpoint, which lacks pagination metadata.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the warehouse ingestion connector to continue syncing account records despite receiving a 400 error on the page immediately following the last complete page, preventing the entire account sync from failing when the account's record count is an exact multiple of the page size.

observations.behavior: Adds a test asserting that account records are retained when the pagination request after the last page returns a 400 error.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that the warehouse ingestion connector preserves account records rather than failing the entire account sync when the pagination request after the last page returns a 400 error.
